entities.summary: Eyal Ofer is an Israeli billionaire, philanthropist and art collector, based in Monaco. Born in Israel, he is involved in real estate, energy, technology and shipping. Ofer is the chairman of Ofer Global, Zodiac Group and Global Holdings. As of March 2026, his net worth is estimated by Forbes at US$33.6 billion.
